Hannah: FYI — bulk ingestion throttling kicked in for several onboarding jobs between 16:20-16:45 UTC. Affected customers report slow or partial search results and delayed index completion. Need concise outbound + plan to prioritize renewal-risk accounts.
Raj: Looking. Throttle was auto-triggered by new queue backpressure logic we shipped last week. It prevented overload but also paused some large batched writes.
Priya: Drafting customer note: short apology, we fixed a throttling rule, offer manual reindex and priority processing, and evaluate credits. Keep language cautious per legal.
Tom: Ops can bump priority and re-run the stuck jobs. ETA ~25m to process backlog; two very large tenants may need manual reindex.
Eve (Legal): Use "may have experienced" not "were affected". Dont promise credits publicly  say "we will evaluate account-level remediation". Also avoid implying data loss.
Hannah: Agreed. Priya, include a link to a short troubleshooting checklist and a calendar invite for office hours. Also prepare a separate high-touch template for renewal-risk list.
Priya: Draft snippet: ```Hi Were reaching out about onboarding delays you may have experienced earlier today. Our team adjusted a throttling configuration that paused some large index writes; weve reset the queue and are prioritizing reprocessing for impacted accounts. If you see missing or partial search results, please reply or contact your CS rep and well re-run indexing for you. Were evaluating account-level remediation and will follow up with an RCA. ```
Raj: Backlog processing started at 16:33 UTC, current throughput bumped 3x. Most tenants should catch up within 20-30 minutes.
Tom: Confirmed. Two tenants with >500M docs flagged for manual reindex; tagging renewals.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-1088 created, severity P3, bridge scheduled.
Priya: High-touch email template ready for renewal-risk accounts with offer for live troubleshooting and prioritized manual reindex. Keeping credit language for approvals only.
Hannah: Send public note once legal sign-off done. Also, after RCA, we need to update onboarding runbooks and add a canary for queue-backpressure changes.
Eve (Legal): Sign-off on wording. Replace "paused" with "temporarily limited" in the public note.
Priya: Updated and uploaded final note to comms folder. Sending after Hannah confirmation. Office hours scheduled at 18:00 UTC.
Hannah: Send now. After customer outreach, tag any responses in the account health tracker and schedule 1:1s for renewal-risk tenants. Thanks. :thumbsup:
